name: GeoStock
summary: Shows per-location stock on the product page plus a store-locator map, so shoppers can see which branch has the item. It displays inventory rather than managing it.
best_for: retailers with physical locations who want shoppers to see per-store stock and find the nearest branch on the product page itself
skip_if: you are online-only — there are no locations to show — or you need actual inventory management, which this is not
honest_knock: Know what this is before you buy it: despite the name it is a storefront widget, not an inventory system. It displays the stock you already track in Shopify per location, and adds a store-locator map — it does not manage, forecast or reconcile anything. If you came looking for multi-location inventory management, that is a different category and a different budget. What it does do well is close a specific gap: a shopper who can see that a nearby store has the item is a shopper who does not abandon.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-20 on apps.shopify.com/product-inventory-information) Two plans, no free tier. Base Plan $9.99 a month and Plus Plan $29.99 a month, both with a 14-day free trial, billed in USD every 30 days. Unchanged since the readings of 18 August and 13 September 2026. Rating 4.9 from 99 ratings (92 five-star, two four-star, no three-star, two two-star, three one-star). Developer sohkal llc, 6381 Almaden Rd, San Jose, CA, US; on the App Store since 28 March 2019.
